آزِلٌ A man in a state of straitness, distress, adversity, or difficulty. (TA.) ―
-b2- A man in a state of straitness in consequence of fever: or who is unable to go forth in consequence of pain: or confined, restricted, withheld, or prevented [from going forth]. (TA.) ―
-b3- لَبُونٌ آزِلَةٌ [A milch camel] confined, or restricted, not pasturing at pleasure, having her shank tied up to her arm, on account of her owner's fear of a hostile incursion: occurring in a poem of El-Aashà. (TA.) ―
-b4- أَزْلٌ آزِلٌ, in the K, erroneously, ↓ أَزِلٌ , Severe, or vehement, straitness, distress, or difficulty. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
